title: Exodus Bible Quiz - Chapter 39
description: Ten questions on Exodus 39: the making of the priestly garments and Moses inspecting the finished work of the tabernacle.

questions.text: How was the gold worked into the ephod?
questions.explanation: They beat the gold into thin plates and cut it into wires, to work it in with the blue, the purple, the scarlet and the fine linen.

answers.text: It was beaten into thin plates and cut into wires
It was melted and poured over the linen
It was ground into dust and sprinkled on
Gold coins were sewn onto the cloth

questions.text: Where were the engraved onyx stones put?
questions.explanation: They put the onyx stones on the shoulder straps of the ephod, to be stones of memorial for the children of Israel.

answers.text: On the front of the turban
On the shoulder straps of the ephod
On the skirts of the robe
On the ends of the sash

questions.text: What was the length of the breastplate?
questions.explanation: The breastplate was square and made double. Its length was a span, and its width a span.

questions.text: Which stones made up the first row of the breastplate?
questions.explanation: A row of ruby, topaz and beryl was the first row.

questions.text: The stones of the breastplate were according to whose names?
questions.explanation: The stones were according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, engraved like a signet, for the twelve tribes.

answers.text: The names of the children of Israel
The names of the camps in the wilderness

questions.text: What color was the robe of the ephod?
questions.explanation: He made the robe of the ephod of woven work, all of blue.

questions.text: What was placed between the pomegranates around the skirts of the robe?
questions.explanation: They made bells of pure gold and put them between the pomegranates around the skirts of the robe.

questions.text: What inscription was written on the plate of the holy crown?
questions.explanation: They made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold and wrote on it, like the engravings of a signet: "HOLY TO YAHWEH".

questions.text: To what was the gold plate fastened with a lace of blue?
questions.explanation: They tied to it a lace of blue, to fasten it on the turban above.

questions.text: What did Moses do after he saw that all the work had been done as Yahweh commanded?
questions.explanation: Moses saw all the work, and they had done it as Yahweh had commanded; and Moses blessed them.

answers.text: He held a feast for them
He gave each of them a reward of silver
He wrote their names in a book
